about_company.about_short: Makes flexible metal flow systems and is expanding into liquid-cooling assemblies for AI data centres.
about_company.business_intro: Aeroflex makes stainless-steel flexible hoses, assemblies, fittings, bellows and liquid-cooling skid assemblies. Customers use them to control liquids and gases in industrial and mission-critical systems; revenue comes from selling engineered components and customised assemblies in India and export markets.
about_company.about_long: Aeroflex's core products are corrugated stainless-steel hoses and value-added assemblies used in oil and gas, chemicals, steel, HVAC, railways and other industries. It has added fittings through Hyd-Air, metal bellows and Secondary Fluid Network skid assemblies used in data-centre liquid cooling. The company manufactures near Mumbai and Pune, sells in more than 90 countries and develops products in-house for specialised applications.

company_timeline.title: Acquired by Aeroflex Enterprises
company_timeline.detail: Aeroflex Enterprises was formerly named Sat Industries.

company_timeline.title: Acquires Hyd-Air Engineering
company_timeline.detail: The acquisition added hydraulic fittings and fluid connectors to the product range.

company_timeline.title: Begins scaling liquid-cooling assemblies
company_timeline.detail: The company disclosed a long-term agreement and initial supply of SFN skid assemblies for data centres.

company_timeline.title: Expands skid capacity to 9,000 units
company_timeline.detail: The disclosed 15,000-unit target remained an expansion plan at Q1 FY27.

business_facts.title: Product mix
business_facts.text: In Q1 FY27, stainless-steel flexible hoses were 41% of revenue, assemblies and other products 37%, and SFN skid assemblies 23%. Percentages are company-reported and rounded.

business_facts.title: Export reach
business_facts.text: Exports were 58% of Q1 FY27 revenue and domestic sales 42%. Within exports, the Americas contributed 57%, Europe 33%, Asia 2%, Africa 7% and other markets 1%. The company reports a presence in more than 90 countries.

business_facts.title: Manufacturing footprint
business_facts.text: Aeroflex reports three manufacturing plants near the JNPT port: Taloja in Navi Mumbai, Lodha-Palava in Thane and Chakan in Pune. The footprint supports hoses, fittings, bellows and liquid-cooling skid assemblies.

business_facts.title: Capacity & utilisation
business_facts.text: Annual hose capacity was 17.5 million metres and skid capacity 9,000 units. Management said hose utilisation was about 65–66%; the planned increases to 20 million metres and 15,000 skids were targeted for Q3 FY27 and were not yet operating capacity.

business_facts.title: R&D pipeline
business_facts.text: The company reports 58 products at different R&D stages, including 16 related to data-centre liquid cooling, supported by 14 qualified R&D staff and a NABL-accredited laboratory. Products in development are not counted as commercial products.

business_facts.title: Custom engineering
business_facts.text: Skid assemblies are made to the cooling-system design for each data-centre floor, so unit values vary with configuration. Management said individual skids supplied have ranged from about ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh; this is not a standard selling-price series.

what_changed.headline: Liquid cooling has become a material revenue line.
what_changed.text: SFN skid assemblies contributed ₹32.4 crore, or about 23% of Q1 FY27 revenue. As that business scaled, domestic revenue share rose to 42% from 28% a year earlier; the company still earned 58% of revenue from exports.
